purpose: Bounded Native evaluation supervisor executed in memory; allows throughput drop and checks continuous training progress.
python:
import os,sys,json,hashlib,subprocess,time,signal,struct,collections,math,pathlib,datetime
from pathlib import Path
from tensorboard.compat.proto.event_pb2 import Event
ROOT=Path('/home/server/liufengrong/robot_lab')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'.agents/skills/monitor-tune-isaaclab-training/scripts'))
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts/reinforcement_learning/rsl_rl'))
from capture_run_identity import capture_run_identity
from capture_effective_training_config import load_and_validate_effective_config
from evidence_provenance import read_reference,store_object,capture_scenario,validate_provenance,write_bytes,encode
TASK='RobotLab-Isaac-Velocity-Flat-LW-wheel-Roa-v0'
RUN='2026-10-02_14-30-02'
BATCH='overlap-native-model22000-20261003-004'
ATTEMPT='native-right15-noise-a01'
run_root=ROOT/'learnings/policy_tuning'/TASK/RUN
log_dir=ROOT/'logs/rsl_rl/LW_wheel_flat_roa'/RUN
training_dir=run_root/'evidence/training'
checkpoint=log_dir/'model_22000.pt'
CKSHA='666ac9d50b7e8c0854ddd47e85cf7cc393b2b2f3f2082b5b8d8cb7582c243558'
assert hashlib.sha256(checkpoint.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==CKSHA
training={'pid':574265,'start_ticks':'93998010','argv':[x.decode() for x in Path('/proc/574265/cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if x]}
old_launch=json.loads((run_root/'evidence/source/launch-wheel-live-model21000gpu1t-20261003-001.json').read_text())
old_identity=read_reference(old_launch['run_identity'])
identity=capture_run_identity(ROOT,task=TASK,run_id=RUN,host_id=old_identity['host_id'],backend=old_identity['backend'],algorithm=old_identity['algorithm'],runner=old_identity['runner'],seed=42,training_command=training['argv'],hydra_overrides=[],config_paths=[x['path'] for x in old_identity['config_files']])
assert identity==old_identity,'Training source identity changed; launch requires renewed provenance'
context_ref=store_object(run_root,'context',identity)
config_ref=old_launch['effective_config']
config,_config_metadata=load_and_validate_effective_config(Path(config_ref['path']),expected_sha256=config_ref['sha256'],run_identity=identity)
for item in config['source_files'].values():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(item['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item['sha256']
scenario=dict(old_launch['scenario'])
assert scenario['duration_steps']==2000
source_ref=old_launch['evaluator_source']
scenario_ref=capture_scenario(identity,scenario,source_ref)
validate_provenance(identity,config_ref,scenario_ref,scenario,live=True)
raw=run_root/'evaluations'/BATCH/'raw'/ATTEMPT
raw.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
monitor_old=json.loads((run_root/'evidence/training/launch-short-model21000-20261003-003.json').read_text())['monitor_source']
monitor_source=monitor_old.replace('overlap-short-model21000-20261003-003-',BATCH+'-')
exec(compile(monitor_source,'<hash-verified-training-tail-reader>','exec'))
before,before_ref=training_snapshot('before')
assert before['process']['identity_matches']
assert before['tensorboard']['step']>22000
print(json.dumps({'stage':'preflight','checkpoint_sha256':CKSHA,'checkpoint_iter':22001,'step':before['tensorboard']['step'],'fps5':before['tensorboard']['metrics']['Perf/total_fps']['mean_last_5'],'context_reused':context_ref,'config_reused':config_ref}),flush=True)
protected={str(ROOT/x['path']):x['sha256'] for x in identity['config_files']}
protected.update({x['path']:x['sha256'] for x in config['source_files'].values()})
protected[str(log_dir/'git/robot_lab.diff')]=hashlib.sha256((log_dir/'git/robot_lab.diff').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
protected[str(ROOT/'learnings/policy_tuning'/TASK/'2026-10-01_00-04-08/index.md')]=hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'learnings/policy_tuning'/TASK/'2026-10-01_00-04-08/index.md').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for p in (run_root/'evaluations').glob('*/manifest.json'):
 protected[str(p)]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 q=p.parent/'report.md';protected[str(q)]=hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
args=[sys.executable,'-B',str(ROOT/'scripts/reinforcement_learning/rsl_rl/evaluate_policy.py'),'--task',TASK,'--run_id',RUN,'--batch_id',BATCH,'--evaluation_id',ATTEMPT,'--candidate_id','model-22000','--checkpoint',str(checkpoint),'--checkpoint_sha256',CKSHA,'--artifact_kind','native','--artifact_path',str(checkpoint),'--artifact_sha256',CKSHA,'--run_identity_path',context_ref['path'],'--run_identity_file_sha256',context_ref['sha256'],'--effective_config_reference_json',json.dumps(config_ref),'--scenario_evidence_reference_json',json.dumps(scenario_ref),'--scenario_id',scenario['scenario_id'],'--scenario_overrides_json',json.dumps(scenario['scenario_overrides']),'--command_schedule_json',json.dumps(scenario['command_schedule']),'--duration_steps','2000','--num_envs','1','--seed','42','--result_path',str(raw/'result.json'),'--telemetry_path',str(raw/'telemetry.json.gz'),'--telemetry_stride','1','--headless','--device','cuda:0','--allow_training_overlap','--no_video']
environment={**os.environ,'OMP_NUM_THREADS':'1','MKL_NUM_THREADS':'1','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS':'1','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'}
launch={'version':1,'record_type':'bounded-native-launch','recorded_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'authorization':'User explicitly requested Native evaluation plus historical hardware-input hip sensitivity comparison, and accepts training slowdown while progress continues. No training control or source edits authorized.','argv':args,'environment_overrides':{k:environment[k] for k in ['OMP_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE']},'context':context_ref,'config':config_ref,'scenario':scenario_ref,'checkpoint':{'path':str(checkpoint),'sha256':CKSHA,'internal_iter':22001},'training':training,'before':before_ref,'monitor_source':monitor_source,'protected_files':protected,'stop_rule':{'throughput_drop_accepted':True,'progress_stale_seconds':180,'wall_timeout_seconds':600,'stop_only_own_evaluator':True}}
write_bytes(training_dir/(BATCH+'-preflight.json'),encode(launch))
console=raw/'console.log'
with console.open('xb') as output:
 proc=subprocess.Popen(args,cwd=ROOT,env=environment,stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
 launch['evaluation_pid']=proc.pid;launch['evaluation_pgid']=os.getpgid(proc.pid)
 write_bytes(training_dir/(BATCH+'-launch.json'),encode(launch))
 print(json.dumps({'stage':'launched','evaluation_pid':proc.pid,'console':str(console),'result':str(raw/'result.json')}),flush=True)
 start=time.monotonic();last_step=before['tensorboard']['step'];last_progress=start;checks=0;reason=None;observations=[before_ref]
 try:
  while proc.poll() is None:
   time.sleep(20)
   if proc.poll() is not None:break
   checks+=1
   current,current_ref=training_snapshot('during-'+str(checks).zfill(2));observations.append(current_ref)
   now=time.monotonic();step=current['tensorboard']['step']
   if step>last_step:last_progress=now;last_step=step
   print(json.dumps({'stage':'monitor','elapsed_s':round(now-start,1),'train_step':step,'train_fps5':current['tensorboard']['metrics']['Perf/total_fps']['mean_last_5'],'training_identity_matches':current['process']['identity_matches']}),flush=True)
   if not current['process']['identity_matches']:reason='training process identity unavailable or changed'
   elif step<last_step:reason='training scalar progress regressed'
   elif now-last_progress>180:reason='training progress unchanged for 180 seconds'
   elif now-start>600:reason='bounded evaluation wall-time limit 600 seconds'
   if reason:break
 finally:
  if proc.poll() is None:
   if reason is None:reason='controller exception; evaluator cleanup only'
   os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
   try:proc.wait(timeout=20)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL);proc.wait(timeout=10)
 returncode=proc.wait()
 after,after_ref=training_snapshot('after');observations.append(after_ref)
 completion={'version':1,'record_type':'bounded-native-completion','recorded_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'evaluation_pid':proc.pid,'returncode':returncode,'reason':reason,'elapsed_s':time.monotonic()-start,'result_exists':(raw/'result.json').exists(),'progress_before':before['tensorboard']['step'],'progress_after':after['tensorboard']['step'],'same_training_identity':after['process']['identity_matches'],'observations':observations}
 write_bytes(training_dir/(BATCH+'-completion.json'),encode(completion))
 print(json.dumps({'stage':'finished',**completion}),flush=True)
